jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Create ML models driving digitisation of real-world infrastructure from LIDAR, imagery, and vector data at Series C utility-AI scale-up.
jobs.description:
## About Neara

Neara is a high-growth, venture-backed Series C technology company headquartered in Sydney, Australia, named in the TIME100 Most Influential Companies of 2024. The company builds 3D physics-enabled digital twins of critical infrastructure networks (power, water, telecoms) to help utilities run simulations and assess risk, working with 75% of utilities in Australia and New Zealand and rapidly expanding across the US and Europe.

## Role Overview

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Neara, you will create machine learning models that drive the digitisation of real-world infrastructure from a variety of data sources including LIDAR point clouds, aerial imagery, and vector geospatial data. You will work across every stage of the ML lifecycle — from data collection and quality assurance through model training, deployment, and production monitoring.

## Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop computer vision and geospatial ML models to extract structured information from raw infrastructure data
- Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, feature engineering, training, evaluation, and inference
- Collaborate closely with infrastructure domain experts, software engineers, and product teams to translate real-world problems into ML solutions
- Establish best practices for model monitoring, retraining workflows, and performance tracking in production
- Contribute to Neara's core ML platform, improving tooling and infrastructure for the broader team

## Requirements

- 5+ years experience in applied machine learning, with production deployment track record
- Strong Python skills and proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow)
- Experience with computer vision, point cloud processing, or geospatial ML preferred
- Hands-on experience with cloud ML infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and MLOps practices
- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment

## Tech Stack

Python, PyTorch, AWS/GCP, MLOps tooling, geospatial data processing, LIDAR processing libraries

## Benefits

- Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth Series C
- Hybrid working from Neara's Sydney office
- Mission-driven work with real-world impact on critical infrastructure resilience

jobs.title: Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.snippet: Build and operate Xero's internal agentic AI platform — LLM gateways, shared SDKs, Kubernetes-based inference — enabling ML teams across the company.
jobs.description:
## About Xero

Xero is a global small-business platform used by over 4 million subscribers in 180+ countries. Based in the heart of Sydney CBD with views of the Harbour Bridge, Xero's engineering teams work on accounting, payroll, and AI-powered features that help small businesses thrive.

## Role Overview

As an Engineer on the AI Platform team, you will build and evolve Xero's internal agentic AI platform, providing the shared infrastructure that allows ML engineers, data scientists, and product engineers to ship AI-powered features reliably at scale. This role can be performed remotely anywhere in Australia or from Xero offices in Sydney, Melbourne, or Brisbane.

## Key Responsibilities

- Design and build platform components using Python, AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes to support AI workloads at scale
- Develop and maintain shared infrastructure including secure LLM gateways, shared AI SDKs, and agent orchestration frameworks
- Build observability tooling for AI systems — latency tracking, cost monitoring, safety guardrails
- Collaborate with ML engineers and product teams to understand platform needs and prioritise improvements
- Drive reliability, security, and efficiency improvements across Xero's AI infrastructure

## Requirements

- 3+ years software engineering experience with a focus on platform, infrastructure, or MLOps
- Strong Python skills; familiarity with cloud infrastructure on AWS
- Experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines
- Understanding of LLM APIs, RAG systems, or AI agent patterns is a strong plus
- Excellent communication skills and ability to work across teams

## Tech Stack

Python, AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock), monitoring tooling

## Benefits

- Flexible remote-first working across Australia
- Comprehensive health and wellbeing benefits
- Share scheme and competitive salary
- Learning and development budget

jobs.title: Data Scientist (QuantumBlack)
jobs.snippet: Build and deploy production ML and AI solutions for top-tier global clients at QuantumBlack, McKinsey's AI arm — Sydney office.
jobs.description:
## About QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey

QuantumBlack is McKinsey's artificial intelligence and data science division, employing 1,500+ engineers, data scientists, product managers, and designers who build AI solutions for the world's most complex business problems. The Sydney team works across financial services, resources, healthcare, and government sectors.

## Role Overview

As a Data Scientist at QuantumBlack in Sydney, you will design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions for McKinsey's global client base. You will work at the intersection of data science, software engineering, and business strategy, translating client challenges into production-ready technical solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

- Build predictive models, recommendation systems, and GenAI applications for enterprise clients
- Work across the full ML lifecycle: problem framing, data engineering, model development, evaluation, and production deployment
- Partner with management consultants and client teams to ensure AI solutions deliver measurable business impact
- Contribute to QuantumBlack's internal platforms, tools, and reusable AI assets
- Mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the Sydney team's technical community

## Requirements

- 3–7 years of experience in data science or applied ML in production environments
- Strong Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and proficiency with SQL
- Track record of deploying ML models to production; MLOps experience valued
- Experience with GenAI, LLMs, or RAG systems is a significant advantage
- Excellent communication skills to translate technical results to non-technical stakeholders
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field

## Tech Stack

Python, SQL, PyTorch/TensorFlow, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), dbt, Spark, MLflow

## Benefits

- Highly competitive salary and performance bonus
- Exposure to world-class problems across industries
- Access to McKinsey's global learning programs
- Sydney CBD office with flexible working

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: Build data pipelines and infrastructure powering Australia's national payments ecosystem — BPAY, NPP, and next-gen real-time payments rails.
jobs.description:
## About Australian Payments Plus

Australian Payments Plus (AP+) is the national payments infrastructure company formed through the merger of BPAY Group, eftpos Australia, and NPP Australia. AP+ operates the payment systems used by millions of Australians daily, including BPAY, PayID/Osko (NPP), and eftpos, and is driving Australia's payments roadmap into the next decade.

## Role Overview

As a Data Engineer at AP+, you will design, build, and maintain the data pipelines and infrastructure that underpin AP+'s analytical and operational capabilities. You will work with large-scale payments transaction data, helping AP+ and its member institutions gain insight into Australia's payments landscape.

## Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain ELT/ETL data pipelines using modern data stack tooling
- Design scalable data models supporting analytics, regulatory reporting, and AI/ML workloads
- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to deliver data products that enable fraud detection, behavioural analytics, and strategic planning
- Ensure data quality, governance, and lineage across AP+'s data platform
- Contribute to the adoption of cloud-native data infrastructure on AWS

## Requirements

- 3–5 years of data engineering experience
- Strong SQL and Python skills
- Experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) and orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt)
- Understanding of event-driven data architecture and streaming (Kafka experience a plus)
- Exposure to payments, fintech, or financial services data is advantageous

## Tech Stack

Python, SQL, AWS, Snowflake/Redshift, dbt, Apache Airflow, Kafka

## Benefits

- Competitive salary + superannuation
- Meaningful work at the heart of Australia's financial infrastructure
- Flexible hybrid working from Sydney CBD
- Professional development support

jobs.title: Research Intern – GenAI
jobs.snippet: Join Appen's GenAI research team to advance multilingual AI, adversarial prompting, and agentic AI systems — hands-on dataset curation and model evaluation in Sydney.
jobs.description:
## About Appen

Appen Limited (ASX: APX) is a global leader in high-quality AI training data, founded in Sydney in 1996. Over 30 years, Appen has built a platform connecting 1 million+ crowd contributors worldwide to create the data that powers AI models at Google, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, and hundreds of other companies. Appen's Sydney headquarters houses its research and technology teams.

## Role Overview

Appens's GenAI Research Team is seeking Research Interns to support cutting-edge research in Generative AI, multilingual AI technologies, and agentic AI systems. You will contribute to projects that advance the safety, inclusiveness, and effectiveness of AI systems across languages and modalities.

## Key Responsibilities

- Conduct literature reviews on topics including adversarial prompting, multilingual LLM evaluation, and agentic AI behaviour
- Assist in dataset curation, annotation workflow design, and quality assurance for speech, text, and multimodal data
- Support model evaluation experiments including prompt engineering, red teaming, and safety benchmarking
- Collaborate with research scientists to analyse model outputs and identify failure modes
- Document research findings and contribute to internal technical reports

## Requirements

- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Linguistics, AI, or related field
- Understanding of multilingual NLP, speech technologies, or agentic AI systems
- Python proficiency; experience with HuggingFace, PyTorch, or similar ML frameworks preferred
- Strong analytical and writing skills
- Genuine interest in AI safety, evaluation, and responsible AI development

## Tech Stack

Python, HuggingFace Transformers, PyTorch, annotation tooling, evaluation frameworks

## Benefits

- Paid internship in Appen's Chatswood (Sydney) office
- Mentorship from senior AI researchers
- Exposure to production-scale AI data pipelines
- Opportunity to contribute to publishable research
